User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the Kintsugi Portal system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of the user's profile image (optional).

DashboardMetrics.title: DashboardMetrics
DashboardMetrics.description: Represents key business metrics displayed on the dashboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DashboardMetrics entity.

date.description: Date for which the metrics are recorded.

totalSales.description: Total sales amount for the given date.

newCustomers.description: Number of new customers acquired on the given date.

averageOrderValue.description: Average order value for the given date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SystemSetting entity.

settingKey.description: The key or name of the setting.

settingValue.description: The value of the setting (can be a string representation of a number, boolean, etc.).

description.description: A description of the purpose of the setting.

InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: Represents a parent inventory item category.

name.description: Name of the inventory item. Also used as the document ID.

description.description: An optional description of the item.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the item was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the item was last updated.

InventoryVariant.title: InventoryVariant
InventoryVariant.description: Represents a specific variant of a parent inventory item.

source.description: Where the item was sourced from.

quantity.description: The number of units available for this variant.

price.description: The price per unit for this variant.

warningLimit.description: The threshold below which the stock is considered low.

description.description: An optional description of the variant.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the variant was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the variant was last updated.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents an item in a user's shopping cart.

parentItemId.description: ID of the parent inventory item.

quantity.description: Number of units of the variant in the cart.

addedAt.description: Timestamp when the item was added to the cart.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to support a business management portal with user authentication (Guest/Admin roles), a dashboard for metrics, and an admin panel for user and settings management. The structure emphasizes security, scalability, and debuggability, adhering to the principles of Authorization Independence, Clarity of Intent, DBAC, and QAPs.

**Authorization Independence:**  Authorization data is denormalized to avoid `get()` calls in security rules.  For example, admin privileges are determined by the existence of a document in `/roles_admin/{userId}`, avoiding the need to read user profile data during authorization.

**Structural Segregation:** Data with different access requirements is stored in separate collections (e.g., public vs. private data).  System settings, which require admin-only access, are stored in `/system_settings`, segregated from user-specific data. Inventory data is in its own collection with specific admin/guest rules, and variants are in a subcollection with admin-only access.

**Access Modeling:** User-owned data will be stored in `/users/{userId}/...`. Global roles are managed via existence checks in dedicated role collections (`/roles_admin/{userId}`).

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure enables secure `list` operations. The segregation of data based on access levels (e.g., system settings in a separate collection) ensures that listing operations can be secured without filtering based on document content.

**Denormalization Strategy:**  The role is denormalized to avoid reads in security rules. The dashboard metrics do not have user based authorization requirements so it will be under a main collection. The system settings require admin only access, which is achieved via role verification.
